words.hours: The hours of low Sun after snow and terrain, in the ten-day periods whose middle day is in the month.
words.ranked: The plan names only ranked areas. A ranked area has a terrain figure, measured snow in the north, and a bare share of at least 0.25.
words.reachable: Reachable: within 100 km of an airfield with scheduled flights. In Antarctica, within 100 km of any listed airfield.
words.distance: Distances are straight lines from the middle of the area to the runway.
words.south: In Antarctica, only the rock season counts, from 27 November to 1 March.
words.snow: Antarctic entries show the words 'snow not measured'.
words.none: If there is no entry, no ranked area has more than 5 h in that month.
words.clear: The clear share is one minus the mean cloud cover of the month, over all hours of day and night.
